reader.requirement: At --std 85 a subscript may be written on data-name-1 (or on condition-name-1) only when that entry (or the condition-name's conditional variable) contains an OCCURS clause or is subordinate to one; a subscript on any other item or group, or on a condition-name whose variable is not in a table, is refused.
